provenance.paper_title: Rethinking Progression of Memory State in Robotic Manipulation: An Object-Centric Perspective

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Spatiotemporally consistent slot identities carry object-specific interaction history into action decoding.

A slot state-space model recurrently updates object-centric memory across manipulation frames. For Embodied-SlotSSM, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of object-centric slot state.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): During inference, the operative memory component (object-centric slot state) changes through a trained but frozen update module; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
